LESSON: CLEANING THE KITCHEN

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Hygiene Practices
Topic 3.1: Cleaning the Kitchen

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Cleaning the Kitchen
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Cleaning the Kitchen
2. give Kenyan examples of Cleaning the Kitchen
3. practise a safe skill for Cleaning the Kitchen

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Cleaning the Kitchen

Teach
• Observe Cleaning the Kitchen in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Cleaning the Kitchen (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Cleaning the Kitchen.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Cleaning the Kitchen.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Cleaning the Kitchen.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Cleaning the Kitchen.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Cleaning the Kitchen: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Cleaning the Kitchen with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
